# Code vApp as Workspace Region

## Principle
The code vApp should be a region of the shared workspace, not a separate product.

## That means
- it shares workstream identity
- it shares chronicle and review
- it shares graph knowledge and imports
- it shares host/repo/runtime bindings
- it is reachable from CLI and GUI
